pages.text: $(bold)Bountiful$() boards post jobs villages want done; pay is emeralds and goods.$(br2)$(bold)Caravans & Convoys$(): wagons that carry trade between settlements. Build a dock or a wagon post and routes open up. This is the mid-game economy before rail.

Late game, the $(bold)Trading Floor$() lets a train sell on a schedule — a depot in a real town, goods in, emeralds out, while you are elsewhere.$(br2)Depots need a Blueprint and a town with a bell and beds. There is no version that works in a hole in the ground.
